text_block_list.name: Tucker Brine
text_block_list.text:
Yo, Trainer! Looks like you're working 
hard!

text_block_list.name: Tucker Brine
text_block_list.text:
Training, racing, and even developing 
Tracen Island—thanks for all your hard 
work every day!

text_block_list.name: Tucker Brine
text_block_list.text:
I found something that might just help you 
out!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"And so, what Tucker Brine pulled out was 
two items."

text_block_list.name: Tucker Brine
text_block_list.text:
I plan to share them with the rest of the 
staff, but I'll give you one first! Which 
one do you want?
choice_data_list:
A book that looks useful for developing a 
deserted island
A Lovely Photo Book of Tracen Island

text_block_list.name: Tucker Brine
text_block_list.text:
This is a real gem that'll make for quite 
the asset, I tell ya!

text_block_list.name: Tucker Brine
text_block_list.text:
Even just flipping through a few pages, it 
was packed with vast amounts of detailed 
info! There's no doubt it'll be a huge 
help to you!

text_block_list.name: Tucker Brine
text_block_list.text:
Glean all the knowledge you can, and 
then... be sure to lend it to me next!

text_block_list.name: Tucker Brine
text_block_list.text:
Nah, the truth is, I've been itching with 
anticipation. Just what kind of knowledge 
am I gonna gain here...?!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I received a book that looks quite useful. 
This should help with the development of 
Tracen Island!

text_block_list.name: Tucker Brine
text_block_list.text:
Haha! As I thought, you want to be 
pampered first! ――No, this is good!

text_block_list.name: Tucker Brine
text_block_list.text:
A photographer friend of mine made a photo 
book of Tracen Island's current scenery 
since we had the chance!

text_block_list.name: Tucker Brine
text_block_list.text:
Turn the page, and you see lush, green 
forests, training facilities 
mid-construction, and participants with 
beaming smiles!

text_block_list.name: Tucker Brine
text_block_list.text:
"We've got some wonderful photos lined up! 
I'd love for you to take your time and 
look through them!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I received a wonderful photo album. I'll 
be sure to savor it later!
